answer: Fake identities can multiply freely, but each demands a fresh bond, so an attacker swarming N sybils pays N times the stake and risks slashing on every dishonest pulse. Sybil resistance here relies on staked ferrous tokens locked for a rolling horizon: each agent must bond real value before its pulse is counted in quorum votes. Legitimate agents recover their bond at horizon end; forgers simply burn capital, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
